scope: Every actual native steering-obstacle check in a prospective independent dynamic Teacher navigation process

input_sources.cloud: Actual /cloud_registered_full after unchanged native finite/Go2-self filtering
input_sources.control_pose: Actual accepted /demo/slam/body_odom in camera_init; no Gazebo robot pose navigation input
input_sources.route_and_target: Actual active SCAN samples and controller steering
input_sources.moving_obstacle_pose: Forbidden as navigation or guard input; passive simulator pose remains separate fixture evidence

fields.sequence: Strictly increasing actual guard invocation sequence, starting at1
fields.compute_ros_clock_ns: Integer ROS sim clock read at original native evaluation
fields.compute_monotonic_wall: Monotonic clock at native evaluation, never refreshed by asynchronous disk write
fields.control_rotation: Native current SLAM body rotation matrix
fields.cloud_callback_ros_clock_ns: ROS sim clock at registered-cloud callback entry
fields.cloud_filtering_body_stamp_ns: Actual nearest accepted SLAM pose used by native self filtering
fields.filtered_xyz_float64_sha256: SHA256 of actual immutable guard cloud as C-order little-endian float64 XYZ; passive original XYZ must reproduce it
fields.filtered_points: Point count in that actual immutable guard buffer
fields.route_float64_sha256: SHA256 of route as C-order little-endian float64
fields.goal_corridor_result: Blocked/clearance/point_count returned by first original obstacle_ahead call
fields.motion_corridor_result: Blocked/clearance/point_count returned by second original obstacle_ahead call
fields.motion_corridor_target: Actual target argument computed by unchanged native steering guard
fields.reference_stamp: Actual checked SCAN association reference stamp
fields.trajectory_archive_file: Accepted actual SCAN NPZ path relative to this run, separately SHA-attested by adjacent JSON
fields.obstacle_hold_before: Native hold state before this evaluation
fields.obstacle_hold_after: Native hold state after the same control callback
fields.clear_start_before_s: Original native clear-since value at evaluation, not a replacement timer
fields.clear_start_after_s: Original native clear-since value after same control callback
fields.clear_elapsed_before_s: Compute ROS clock minus native clear-start when present
fields.clear_elapsed_after_s: After-control ROS clock minus native clear-start when present
fields.command_after_control: Actual requested controller vx/vy/wz, not an assertion of accepted/delivered Teacher command
fields.zero_requested_after_control: Whether actual requested controller command is exactly zero
fields.evidence_queue_error: Asynchronous audit writer error if present; overflow/errors are never silently treated as complete evidence

geometry_execution: Original steering_obstacle_ahead code object/defaults/closure execute with private namespace interception of its original two obstacle_ahead calls. No additional corridor evaluation or changed return value.
transport: Bounded asynchronous existing evidence writer, no fsync in callbacks; sequence and drained writer receipt must independently match actual lines
claim: Prospective evidence schema only; no navigation, obstacle-recovery or physical-motion pass is inferred from logging
